name: Living room (measured)
notes: No microphone calibration loaded - treating the phone mic as flat. Bass and low-mid corrections are still useful, but expect errors of several dB above ~4 kHz and possibly below ~40 Hz.
The speakers roll off below about 52 Hz; nothing below that is corrected.
Deep narrow dip around 366 Hz left alone: it is a room null (cancellation). EQ cannot fill it; moving the seat or the subwoofer can.
